Class NovaSimSupplier

java.lang.Object
yams.core.motorcontrollers.simulation.NovaSimSupplier
All Implemented Interfaces:
SimSupplier
public class NovaSimSupplier extends Object implements SimSupplier
A simulated Thrifty Nova driving a mechanism's SimSupplier. ThriftyLib's simulation ignores the Nova's closed loop, so this runs it as the Nova would, with the gains read back from the Nova: the voltage position and velocity loops with the PID slot's gains, its F times the target and the motion profile slot's kS and kG (and kV times a velocity target), and the motion profile with its slot's kS, kV, kA and kG. It keeps within the Nova's soft limits, and, with its absolute wrapping on, takes a position the short way, one mechanism rotation apart. Targets and gains are in mechanism rotations, as on a Nova with its sensor-to-mechanism ratio set, and the integral and derivative gains are per second, as the Nova's are. Open loop output, a duty cycle or a voltage, is passed on to the mechanism.
